title: Ant Group Releases Open Weights for Ling-3.1-flash-1019 AI Model
summary:
The fintech giant has expanded its contributions to the AI community by making the internal parameters of its latest intelligence model available for public download. The new Ling-3.1-flash-1019 version earned a 44 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3.2, surpassing the 41 posted by the previous Ling-3.1-flash release.

Along with the flash weights, Ant Group released Ling-3.1-flash-base, which is designed as an open foundation for external developers to use for further model training and fine-tuning.
